property_summary: After a burn call by any account, the owner address remains unchanged.
After a burn call by any account, the owner address remains the same.
After a call to burn(uint256), the owner remains the same as before the call.
After any successful burn call, the owner address is always equal to the original deployer.
For any caller and any value, after calling burn, the owner of the contract is always the original deployer (address(this)).
After a call to burn(uint256), the owner address remains unchanged.
After calling burn(uint256) with any value, the owner address remains the address that deployed the contract.
The state variable owner is always equal to the initial deployer address after any call to burn().
The owner state variable is always set to the address of the contract deployer after any successful or reverting burn call.
After a call to burn(uint256) that succeeds (i.e., does not revert and returns true), the owner address is the address that called the burn function.
After a call to burn(uint256), totalSupply never increases.
After a call to burn(_value), totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
After a call to burn(uint256), totalSupply plus balanceOf[msg.sender] never increases, i.e., (totalSupply + balanceOf[msg.sender]) does not increase.

After a call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply is always less than or equal to the sum of the previous totalSupply and balanceOf[msg.sender] before the burn, ensuring that totalSupply does not increase by more than the amount burned.
After a call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply minus the sum of all balanceOf entries is always non-negative.
After burn, totalSupply decreases by exactly the burned amount
After a call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply must be less than the totalSupply before the call.
After calling burn, the invariant totalSupply >= balanceOf(owner) holds.
After a burn, totalSupply should equal sum of all balances.
The totalSupply after burn is equal to the totalSupply before burn minus the burn amount, even when the caller is not the owner.
After a burn, totalSupply equals the sum of all balanceOf plus mintedAmount minus burned amount over the whole life, which is invariant across multiple mint and transfer calls.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn, totalSupply is at least as large as the sum of all balanceOf entries (i.e., no supply is unaccounted for).
totalSupply decreases by exactly the burn amount after a burn call, regardless of prior mints.
After calling burn, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burned amount
After any call to burn, both totalSupply and the caller's balance decrease by exactly the burned amount, leaving all other balances unchanged.
The caller's balance after burn is less than or equal to its balance before burn.
After burn, the total supply decrease equals the caller's balance decrease.
The sum of all balances remains unchanged after a call to burn.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply decreases by the burned amount.
After calling burn(uint256), the caller's balance decreases by the burned amount.
The balanceOf the caller after burn is exactly its prior balance minus the burned amount.
After any call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply is always equal to the sum of all balanceOf entries.
After any call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply plus the caller's balanceOf equals the pre-call totalSupply, which is read before the call via a view function.
After any sequence of operations ending with a burn, balanceOf of the owner equals totalSupply.
After any call to burn, totalSupply is at least the sum of balanceOf over all addresses that have ever been minted or transferred to.
After any sequence ending with a burn, the totalSupply is equal to the sum of balanceOf over all addresses (here, implicitly the owner has the only non-zero balance post-mint).
After any sequence ending with a burn, the sum of balanceOf for the owner and the caller is at most the totalSupply.
After any sequence ending with a burn, the sum of all balanceOf values (checked via owner balance) equals totalSupply.
After burn, total supply decreases by the burned amount and the caller's balance decreases by the same amount.
After any burn, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After a burn, the sum of all balances that are not the caller's remains unchanged.
After a burn, the sum of balanceOf[caller] and balanceOf[any other address] is unchanged.
After any burn, the total balance of any two distinct non-caller addresses remains unchanged.
The frozenAccount mapping remains unchanged after a burn call by any account.
Freezing an account does not affect whether another frozen account value changes after a burn call.
After any burn call, the mapping frozenAccount of the caller's own address remains unchanged.
After a burn call, the frozenAccount mapping for any address other than the burner remains unchanged.
After burning tokens, the frozen status of any address that was previously frozen remains unchanged.
transfer always returns true when it completes without revert
The return value of transfer equals the success status of the preceding burn call.
The return value of transfer is always equal to the boolean negation of the frozen status of the sender just before the call.
The return value of transfer does not depend on the fee parameter passed to burn.
The return value of transfer is always false when the sender is frozen, but can be true or false otherwise.
After a burn call, the owner's balance is always less than or equal to the previous total supply.
After a burn call with a non-zero value, the frozen status of any account remains unchanged.
After any call to burn(uint256), the frozenAccount status of the contract address itself remains false.
After a burn call, the frozenAccount status of the caller remains unchanged.
The owner's frozenAccount status is always false after any burn call.
When burn completes without reverting, it returns true.
When burn completes without reverting, the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
When burn completes without reverting, the return value is true.
When burn completes without reverting, the message sender's balance after the burn equals the balance before the burn minus _value.
After any successful burn (non-reverting), the return value is true.
The return value of burn(uint256) is always exactly true.
After a burn call, totalSupply does not change.
The return value of burn(uint256) is always false.
After a successful burn, the totalSupply changes exactly by the burn amount.
After calling burn, the balanceOf the owner remains unchanged.
After calling burn with any value, the balance of the owner never increases.
After calling burn(uint256) with any value, the caller's balance either stays the same or decreases by exactly the input value.
After burn(uint256) is called, the owner's balance remains unchanged only when _value is zero or positive.
After calling burn(uint256) with _value > 0, the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value if the caller's balance was >= _value.
After burn(uint256) returns true, the caller's balance is always decreased by exactly _value.
After calling burn(uint256) on the contract, the totalSupply decreases by exactly the value provided, and the caller's balance changes by exactly the negative of the value.
After calling burn(uint256), the caller's balance decreases by exactly the value provided, and totalSupply decreases by the same value.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value and the caller's balance does not increase.
After calling burn(uint256), the sum of caller's balance and totalSupply does not increase compared to before the burn.
After a burn call, the burning address's balance minus the burned amount is less than or equal to its balance before the burn.
After calling burn(uint256), the owner's balance remains the same as before the call.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
After burn(uint256), the event data at index 0 (from) is msg.sender of the transaction.
After calling burn(uint256), the balance of the caller after the call equals the original balance minus the _value parameter.
After calling burn(uint256), the Burn event's from field equals the caller's address, not address(0).
After burn, totalSupply can never be less than sum of balances minus the burned amount.
After burn, the totalSupply decreased exactly equals the burned amount.
After a burn, the owner's balance never increases.
After burning, totalSupply should be strictly less than before the burn if and only if the burn amount is positive.
After a burn, the total supply should decrease by exactly the burn amount.
After any mint token operation by the owner, the total supply must be greater than or equal to the sum of all previously minted amounts and initial total supply.
After any number of mintToken and burn operations, the totalSupply should always be exactly the sum of all mints minus the sum of all burns.
After a burn, totalSupply plus the burned amount equals the total supply before the burn.
